# E20 build plan

This is a plan for senior review, not a build greenlight. The design stays frozen. SYSTEM and coordinator Part A win, followed by the cold review. Author conformance is not independent approval (docs/tdd/reviews/E20.conformance.md:3).

At inspection, `hub/`, `ui/`, `eval/`, `packaging/`, `deploy/`, generated general API contracts and general runtime configuration are absent. Existing contracts/configuration belong to pharmacy. All 89 E20 implementation paths are absent and partitioned as exact files from docs/tdd/E20.md:590. Other plan ownership inspected: E01, E02, E03, E04, E05, E10, E12, E13, E15, E19, E21, E23, E24, E25, E28 and E32, plus initially empty E07/E08/E09/E14 plans. No task takes their files. Empty task lists do not authorize using another epic's design paths. Recheck ownership immediately before dispatch because planning is concurrent.

## Build order and connections

| Task | Concern | Local dependencies | Completion boundary |
|---|---|---|---|
| T1 | Supervisor, native CLI shell, settings and sanitized crashes | None | Bounded restart/ownership, safe admission and accepted provider CLI integration |
| T2 | Verified static assets, versioned document store and owner-encrypted queue | None | Atomic/pinned offline generations and immutable owner-partitioned intents |
| T3 | Signed artifact verification, native builder and installer admission | None | Bounded verification/staging and provider-controlled install/rollback integration |
| T5 | Accessible operation and its printed input backup | T1, T2 | Actual browser tasks/contrast and pinned printed check; E03 fixes its screens |
| T4 | Native/compose deployment, CI and recovery runbook | T1, T2, T3, T5 | Real offline target installation, profiles and executable CI evidence |
| T6 | Combined fault, offline, privacy and mission-day acceptance | T1, T2, T3, T4, T5 | Every E20 scenario/critical path and required measured reference evidence |

Start T1/T2/T3 together once E01 protocols, generated contracts and kernel.testing exist. Pure component work can proceed against those exact ports/fakes. T3's unit builder/admission work needs no T1/T2 source import; target assembly and installation of their complete outputs is T4. T5 and T3 can overlap once T1/T2 are ready. Wait on the specific external binding listed below before its dependent implementation. No agent may implement a speculative shared protocol to keep moving.

T1 launches E01's hub through its startup sequence; E01 alone owns SQLite, transactions, command identity, private barriers, recovery and assembly. T2 builds from E01's validated raw release bytes, supplies E03/E26/E28's shared cache and preserves their pins. E02 supplies current owner/device/revocation state; DEPLOYMENT 5.5.1 supplies queue-key lifecycle. T3 signs/verifies software inventory and delegates switching to E01, model identity to E17 and evidence installation to E10. T4 packages these outputs and wires workflows to E21's runner; T6 runs the repository-wide jobs after its tests exist. T5 exercises production routes without owning their fixes. T6 drives the assembled stack and hands defects back to owners.

Every standalone brief contains authority references, exact boundaries, tests, failure cases and gates. Only its owned files may change. No task owns a clinical table, migration, HTTP endpoint or public event. No new registration string, provider DTO, CLI spelling, artifact lifecycle or private-key protocol is inferred from a filename.

## End-to-end evidence

Acceptance uses the normal E01 `create_app(settings)` composition root, HTTP and real SQLite in a temporary data directory, or Playwright against that running hub. No mocks or overrides inside the hub. E21 supplies explicit demo provisioning; only absent optional external parts or documented external worker fakes are allowed. Unit fakes never prove acceptance. Tests name the section 12 T-E20 IDs, R/V/D/invariant traces and actual collected nodes. Missing providers, hardware or human task review remain blocked/unrun criteria and cannot yield full acceptance.

| Scenario or critical path | Owner and test IDs | What the real-stack test proves |
|---|---|---|
| V01, D15, D41; immediate help | T6, 035/036 | Stop model and ground, press before sign-in/save; fixed entry and steps render within 500 ms, no intervening model invocation, roles below steps. Actual combined-load native/full runs separately prove contention; disabled mixed workers do not prove it. |
| R62, V97; hub loss | T6, 035 | Open authorized active plan/teach and help, stop hub, show pinned public steps/version; browser restart reveals no cached clinical run. Corrupt active/last-good/bootstrap together and meaningful independently verified static help survives. |
| R25, V16; accepted records | T6, 037/057 | HTTP capture and actual documented adapter sequence batches survive before/after-commit/response death, concurrent retries, target/parameter mismatch and retries after 24 hours. One logical acceptance, original receipt/audit identity; no generic-409 success. |
| R25, V35; UI recovery | T6, 038 | Restart between accepted reading and UI update; real event cursor replay/refetch recovers records and exposes incomplete requests. Cursor expiry cannot fabricate missing ordering evidence. |
| V27; optional inference failure | T6, 040 | Long inference and malformed output through real E13/E17 separately leave cancel/urgent controls usable and assessment visibly incomplete; no fabricated finding. |
| V69; minimum station | T6, 039 | Whole injected mission day with model stopped, devices absent and link down: check, routine/misses, actual rule/sensor warnings, fixed help, records and authorized sharing work; no insight, stopped card, missing/conflicting input remains explicit. |
| R24, V36, E20-01/04 | T5, 041 to 048 | Keyboard check/routine/help and no-color failure/unknown interpretation on real routes/states; all regions, lock announcements, grayscale marks, reduced motion, actual gradient pixels and configured Q17 behavior. Screen-reader/task evidence is required too. |
| R25; process availability | T1 isolated tests, T6 022/023/054 | All children alive across supervisor failure, including spawn-receipt gap and reused PID; correct bounded reconciliation, no duplicate/uncontrolled child, safe epoch handling, loud fault and cached help. |
| R25; install/restore durability | T6, 007/014 to 017; T4, 025/028 | Real paired barrier, exclusive maintenance across every phase/crash, actual migration/new record/code rollback; schema/namespaces/evidence/audit/receipt/incarnation/custody checks and honest verified cutoff/gaps. |
| Private recovery and grants | T6, 015/017/034/057 | Old backup after A deletion preserves A's revocation and B's current owner access; stale/missing vault and old restored grants/session/device rows cannot authorize reads/export/replay. B cannot decrypt A's browser queue; A can unlock after restart and replay once. |
| Configuration integrity and pins | T2 unit/HTTP tests, T6 031 to 035 | Raw-byte identity and trusted signature, all loader checks, nonclinical label edit without code, invalid release retains last good, old open/queued/tab pins survive repeated activation/quota, no warning lowering or negative stock. |
| Record entry without the screen | T5, 049 | Remove app, complete a blank pinned printed questionnaire from the same validated release; no unmeasured estimate. A scratch label edit changes the output without code. E26/E28 supply help/plan cards. |
| R26, E20-03; deployable artifact | T4, 020/024 to 030/050/053 | Two clean normalized builds, independently trusted signatures, complete runtime/native/browser/lock/SBOM inventory, all original nine component IDs plus expansions, clean offline VM install/upgrade/rollback and actual profile connectivity. Declarations remain separate from E21 observed LIVE evidence. |
| AGENTS 6 full disk/outage/privacy | T6, 018/019/023/032/034/039/054/057 | Loud failed writes retain queue/pins/good backup/static help, all time/provenance survives retry and long outage, no cross-crew/P3 leakage to any cache/error/log/diagnostic/export. |

These rows cover every E20 V and D scenario in docs/tdd/E20.md:569. Every section 12 test is assigned in tasks.json. T1 owns 001/002/004/005/018/019/020/022/029/052/055 component evidence; T2 owns 031/032/033/034/057 component evidence; T3 owns 020/024/025/026 admission/parser evidence; T5 owns 041 to 049; T4 owns 025/026/028/030/050/053 target evidence; T6 owns destructive/full-stack 007/014 to 019/022/023/031 to 040/052/054/057 and reference 036. Shared test IDs mean complementary clauses, not duplicate implementation or permission to omit a clause.

They are not waivers merely because conformance says fixed.

This assignment permits edits only in docs/build/E20/, so new planning requests here require coordinator propagation to the canonical request file before they can be decided. No user product confirmation is needed.

## Verification and release conditions

Exact task commands are in tasks.json, adapted only by selecting the owned paths from E20 section 15. The runner project correction comes from E21 section 15. Ruff/strict mypy/import checks apply to each Python task; TypeScript tasks also run typecheck/eslint/prettier and their actual tests. End-to-end selectors name complete files/configurations, without `-k` exclusions. After a bug fix, rerun the complete E20 suite and required shared gates. No missing path/tool/provider or waived criterion may appear green. Repository-wide scenario/e2e and final CI gates belong to T6 so earlier tasks never depend on tests created downstream. The shared gate must accept the scoped evidence requested in P-E20-1 before component dispatch; it cannot require unfinished downstream acceptance to pass.

Executed during planning: `.venv/bin/python -B scripts/design_lint.py docs/tdd/E20.md`, exit 1. Check 10 reports signature mismatches at E20 lines 74/79/83 and zero provider declarations at 78/84/87; all other checks report zero errors/warnings. R-E20-16 needs updating with this evidence by its owner. This plan does not change the gate or frozen design.

Plan-only checks validate JSON shape/DAG, disjoint exact ownership inside E20 section 13, current cross-epic ownership, complete section 12 test-ID allocation, source paths and prohibited punctuation. Implementation, CI, human task review and target hardware gates have not run. Missing implementations prevent those commands running now; that is not evidence of a passing build.
